measures.name: Known Flag Count
measures.description: Exact recorded Yes plus No flags; excludes unknown flags.

measures.name: Timely Response Rate
measures.description: Timely Yes Count divided by Known Flag Count; undefined is BLANK.

measures.description: Untimely No Count divided by Known Flag Count; undefined is BLANK.

measures.description: Frequency-weighted median of valid lags; averages both middle observations; empty is BLANK.

measures.name: Monthly Issue Share
measures.description: Issue frequency divided by all issues in current month context; all other filters retained; undefined is BLANK.
